cim: Opinion: Trump administration shows no ‘super intelligence’
cim_eredeti: Opinion: Trump administration shows no ‘super intelligence’
szoveg_eredeti:
President Donald Trump delivered an edict to the U.N. General Assembly: U.S. government agencies will stop using the term artificial intelligence and start using his chosen term of super intelligence.

According to many news outlets, the U.S. military used artificial intelligence, with parameters set by humans, when it identified the Iranian girls school, Shajareh Tayyebeh, in Minab as a bombing target back in February. Iranian officials report over 150 people were killed including 100 students. The decision to bomb was based on 10-year-old intelligence, back when the area was a military compound (closed in 2016).

I'm going to stop here with giving examples.

Maybe calling it stupid intelligence, lazy intelligence, half-baked intelligence, bad intelligence or old intelligence would be more appropriate.

But super intelligence? I don't think so.
